name: Batch Output Writer
description: Writes batch session-test results to an absolute local directory. Exists because a static-spa iframe cannot write arbitrary local paths.
_comment: Dev-only Executa for the Session Lifecycle Test app's batch tab; it is never published, so only the `local` distribution profile exists. The dev fields (tool_id/type/command/enabled) are what `anna-app dev` reads; `tool_id` here MUST match the DEV_FALLBACK_TOOL_ID in src/batch-writer-client.js, which is used only when bundle/anna-tool-ids.js is absent. This dir is the `batch-writer` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas, so manifest.json refers to it as `bundled:batch-writer`.
